nodes.name: Build product matching in Tender Worker
nodes.notes: Posts all uploaded binary files to POST /product-matching/from-documents. Override URL with TENDER_PRODUCT_MATCHING_URL.

parameters.content:
## Product matching from documents

1. The form accepts one archive or multiple tender documents.
2. The Code node sends files to Python Worker: POST /product-matching/from-documents.
3. Worker parses documents, runs LLM document analysis, consolidates products without duplicates, searches Qdrant/catalog, and returns XLSX.

Required env: TENDER_PYTHON_API_KEY. Optional env: TENDER_PRODUCT_MATCHING_URL.
